savy.prompt: In what year did Singapore gain independence, and from which country?
savy.answer: 1965, from Malaysia — and Singapore was actually expelled, not by choice! 🇸🇬

savy.prompt: What does the word Sentosa mean in Malay?
savy.answer: Peace and tranquility — though it was originally called Pulau Belakang Mati, meaning island behind death! 😱

savy.prompt: The S.E.A. Aquarium showcases 10 ocean zones from two oceans. Name any 3 of the world's 5 major oceans.
savy.answer: Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern, Arctic — 5 oceans! The Pacific alone covers a third of Earth 🌊

savy.prompt: Singapore is one of the world's most densely populated countries. Roughly how many people live per square kilometre?
savy.answer: About 8,000 per km² — the 2nd most densely populated country on Earth! 🏙️

savy.prompt: Night Safari was the world's first nocturnal zoo. In which decade did it open?
savy.answer: The 1990s — specifically 1994! It took 7 years to plan and build 🌙

savy.prompt: Orangutans share approximately what percentage of DNA with humans?
savy.answer: About 96.9%! We share 98.7% with chimps, and even 85% with mice 🧬🦧

savy.prompt: Singapore is one of only 3 remaining city-states in the world. Name one of the other two.
savy.answer: Monaco and Vatican City! Singapore is by far the largest of the three 🏙️

savy.prompt: teamLab is a world-famous digital art collective. In which country was it founded, and roughly what year?
savy.answer: Japan — founded in Tokyo in 2001 by Toshiyuki Inoko. Now in cities all over the world 🇯🇵🎨

savy.prompt: There are 18 Supertrees at Gardens by the Bay, ranging from 25m to 50m tall. What eco feature do many of them have?
savy.answer: Solar panels and rainwater collectors! They're not just pretty — they're sustainable 🌳⚡

savy.prompt: Singapore uses the SGD. Is it worth more or less than the Australian Dollar right now — and how can you check?
savy.answer: Look up the exchange rate! Around mid-2025, roughly 1 SGD ≈ $1.10 AUD, so SGD is a bit stronger 💱

savy.prompt: Universal Studios Singapore opened in which year, and was it the first Universal Studios in Asia?
savy.answer: 2010 — and it was the SECOND in Asia (Japan opened in 2001). It was the first in Southeast Asia 🎥

savy.prompt: The Rain Vortex at Jewel Changi falls 40 metres inside a massive glass dome. Roughly how many glass panels does the dome use?
savy.answer: About 9,000 glass panels covering 136,000 m²! The whole building was designed by Moshe Safdie 🏗️

tay.prompt: What ocean do planes fly over to get from Perth to Singapore?
tay.answer: The Indian Ocean! ✈️ You flew over it to get here!

tay.prompt: There's a famous half-lion, half-fish statue in Singapore. What is it called?
tay.answer: The Merlion! It's Singapore's most famous symbol 🦁🐟

tay.prompt: At the aquarium today, find and remember: one animal that glows, one that has spots, and one that looks scary. Tell Mum or Dad!
tay.answer: Great spotting! The ocean is full of amazing creatures 🐠🌊

tay.prompt: While swimming today, count how many times you can jump and splash without stopping. What's your record? Tell everyone!
tay.answer: Splash champion! 💦 What an amazing record!

tay.prompt: What do we call animals that sleep during the day and come out at night?
tay.answer: Nocturnal! 🌙 Like owls, bats, and all the animals at Night Safari!

tay.prompt: Orangutans are APES not monkeys. What is one difference between an ape and a monkey?
tay.answer: Apes have no tail! Orangutans, gorillas and chimps are all apes 🦧

tay.prompt: Find 3 things in a shop today that you've never seen before. Tell someone what they are!
tay.answer: Great exploring! Singapore has so many unique things 🛍️

tay.prompt: After visiting teamLab, draw your own piece of glowing digital-inspired art on paper using at least 3 colours. Show Mum or Dad!
tay.answer: You're an artist! 🎨 teamLab would love your work!

tay.prompt: The giant glowing tree-like structures at Gardens by the Bay are called what?
tay.answer: Supertrees! 🌳 They're covered in plants and light up at night!

tay.prompt: Find something in a shop that costs less than $3 SGD. What did you find? (Don't spend your star money yet!)
tay.answer: Savvy shopper! 🛍️ Great bargain hunting in Singapore!

tay.prompt: Before going on the biggest ride at Universal Studios, describe it to Mum or Dad — how high, how fast, and how scary out of 10?
Jewel Changi Airport has the world's tallest indoor waterfall. What is it called?
tay.answer: The Rain Vortex! 💧 It's 40 metres tall — as tall as a 13-storey building!
